items.quote: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek
items.claim: Joshua followed Moses' instruction and fought against Amalek.
items.mechanism: command from Moses carried out by Joshua

items.quote: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill
items.claim: Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill while the fight with Amalek took place.
items.place: top of the hill (not named in the document)
